name: retro secrets
tagline: Generates ASCII art that hides an encrypted message in its colours, with creation recorded on-chain.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of Solana // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de Solana

problem: The team wanted a playful way to share hidden messages with provable authorship.
solution: Gemini creates ASCII-optimised art; a message is AES-encrypted and hidden in character colours; the art is registered on Solana for ownership and timing; a social feed shares it.
demo_moment: Team-described: create art, hide a message and verify the original by re-hashing.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Solana // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de Solana” among 260 submissions.
Uses the chain for provenance rather than speculation.

lessons: Give a blockchain a job it is suited to: proving who made what, and when.
